Q: This is the recorded statement for claim reference regarding the collision you reported. Please state your full name
for the record.
A: I'd rather just give my details without my name going on this, if that's alright.
Q: Understood. We can use the claim number instead. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was an intersection in Houston, Texas. I was making a left turn across the opposing lane when another vehicle
struck the rear quarter of my car.
Q: Were you turning at a traffic signal or a stop sign?
A: Three was a signal. My light was green for the turn, I think, though it had been yellow for a moment befroe I went.
Q: How fast were you traveling when you started the turn?
A: Not fast. I was almost stopped waiting for a gap. The other car came through quickly.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Only for a second. I glanced up and it was already close, so I couldn't react in time.
Q: Did you feel any injury at the scene?
A: Not rgiht away. I was sore in my neck and loewr back by that evening, and it's gotten worse over the days since.
Q: Have you seen a medical provider for those symptoms?
A: Yes, I went in for an evaluation. They diagnosed a neck and back strain and I've been doing physical therapy twice
a week.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Just that I'm still having stiffness when I drive, and I'd like the repair and medical costs looked at as soon as
possible.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
